run_locobot_base_navigation: run a pyrobot vrep_locobot base to move to an absolute position using go_to_absolute
run_locobot_camera_capture: run a pyrobot vrep_locobot camera to capture RGB and depth images and save them to disk
run_locobot_arm_joint_control: run a pyrobot vrep_locobot arm to set joint positions and read back joint angles
run_locobot_arm_ik: run a pyrobot vrep_locobot arm to compute inverse kinematics from end-effector pose
run_locobot_arm_ee_control: run a pyrobot vrep_locobot arm to set end-effector pose and move by displacement in task space
